title: Speaking Practice 14 - Describe a Useful Skill You Learned
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a useful skill you learned recently.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Useful Skill You Learned
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a useful skill you learned recently.

You should say: what the skill is, how you learned it, how long it took, and explain why it is useful.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a useful skill you learned recently.

explanation.sampleAnswer: I recently learned how to cook basic meals. I started during the lockdown when I could not eat out. I watched YouTube tutorials and practiced every day. It took about two months to feel confident. This skill saves me money, helps me eat healthier, and gives me a sense of independence.

questions.content: What skills do you think young people should learn?

explanation.sampleAnswer: I think financial literacy and basic cooking are essential. Many young people graduate without knowing how to manage money or prepare a meal.

questions.content: Is it easier to learn new skills now than in the past?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Much easier, thanks to the internet. Free resources like YouTube, Coursera, and Khan Academy make learning accessible to anyone with a connection.
